offering_description.value: Develops and sells hair repair and care products for salons, stylists, and consumers. It uses contract manufacturers and sells through professional distributors, beauty retailers, and its own website.

primary_products.value: bond repair treatments; shampoos and conditioners; hair masks; hair oils and serums; styling products

customer_segment.value: B2B: Salon product distributors, beauty retailers, salons, and independent stylists; B2C: Consumers buying premium hair care for home use

end_markets.value: professional salon hair care; prestige consumer hair care

revenue_model.value: product sales: Professional treatments and take-home hair care sold wholesale and directly to consumers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Develops hair care formulas, outsources production, and sells finished products to distributors, retailers, and consumers

geography_served.value: global: United States and international markets across Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: Bond repair treatments, daily hair care, and styling products for salon and home use

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Professional beauty distributors supplying salons and stylists; third-party retail: Specialty beauty retailers and their websites; online: Company website and third-party marketplaces

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Hair cosmetics are subject to U.S. FDA and EU rules on product safety, labeling, and reporting.
